questions.question: The Carnatic music trinity consists of Tyagaraja, Muthuswami Dikshitar and:
questions.rationale: The three masters, all associated with Tiruvarur in the late 18th century, anchor the Carnatic kriti repertoire. Purandara Dasa is the 'father of Carnatic music' but not of the trinity.

questions.question: The gharana system is a feature of which classical music tradition?
questions.rationale: Hindustani music's master-disciple lineages — Gwalior, Agra, Jaipur, Kirana and others — define styles; Carnatic music organised differently, around the trinity's compositions.

questions.question: Pandit Shivkumar Sharma is associated with which instrument?
questions.rationale: He carried the Kashmiri santoor from folk accompaniment to the classical concert stage — one of the cleanest instrument-maestro pairs in the paper.

questions.question: Who was the first musician to receive the Bharat Ratna?
questions.rationale: The Carnatic vocalist received it in 1998; Lata Mangeshkar (2001) and Bismillah Khan and Bhimsen Joshi (2008) followed.

questions.question: 'Bani Thani', often called the 'Mona Lisa of India', belongs to which painting school?
questions.rationale: The elongated, arched-brow portrait is Kishangarh's masterpiece — with Kangra the standard decoy among the Pahari and Rajasthani options.

questions.question: Raja Ravi Varma is celebrated as:
options: The father of modern Indian painting
questions.rationale: The Kerala prince fused European oil realism with Indian mythology — the title every exam attaches to his name.

questions.question: The mridangam is the primary percussion instrument of:
questions.rationale: The mridangam drives the southern system's tala; the tabla holds the same seat in Hindustani music — the cleanest north-south pair in the section.

questions.question: Warli painting, with its white stick figures, is a folk art of:
questions.rationale: The Adivasi tradition of Maharashtra's coastal belt paints in rice paste on mud walls — Madhubani (Bihar) is its habitual decoy.

questions.question: Ustad Bismillah Khan is inseparably associated with the:
questions.rationale: The shehnai's greatest exponent played at Delhi's Red Fort on 15 August 1947 — the instrument-man pairing papers quote most.

questions.question: The Ajanta murals, masterpieces of ancient Indian painting, are chiefly:
questions.rationale: The Buddhist cave monasteries of the Deccan (c. 2nd century BCE to 6th century CE) hold the graceful figures that every later school borrowed from.
